CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( MSGKEY INT NOT NULL, SUBJECT VARCHAR(120), PHONE VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, CALLBACK VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, STATUS VARCHAR(2) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, REQDATE DATETIME NOT NULL, MSG VARCHAR(4000), FILE_CNT INT DEFAULT 0, FILE_CNT_REAL INT DEFAULT 0, FILE_PATH1 VARCHAR(128), FILE_PATH1_SIZ INT, FILE_PATH2 VARCHAR(128), FILE_PATH2_SIZ INT, FILE_PATH3 VARCHAR(128), FILE_PATH3_SIZ INT, FILE_PATH4 VARCHAR(128), FILE_PATH4_SIZ INT, FILE_PATH5 VARCHAR(128), FILE_PATH5_SIZ INT, EXPIRETIME VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT '43200' NOT NULL, SENTDATE DATETIME, RSLTDATE DATETIME, REPORTDATE DATETIME, READDATE DATETIME, TERMINATEDDATE DATETIME, RSLT VARCHAR(10), TYPE VARCHAR(2) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, TELCOINFO VARCHAR(10), ROUTE_ID VARCHAR(20), ID VARCHAR(20), POST VARCHAR(20), ETC1 VARCHAR(64), ETC2 VARCHAR(32), ETC3 VARCHAR(32), ETC4 INT, MULTI_SEQ VARCHAR(10), KISA_ORIGCODE VARCHAR(20), REAL_ID VARCHAR(10) )

mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1000 MSGKEY AS [key], REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(19),REQDATE,120),'-',''),' ',''),':','') AS request_date, ID AS department_code, PHONE AS phone, CALLBACK AS callback_number, SUBJECT AS title, MSG AS message, TYPE AS message_type, FILE_CNT AS contents_count, FILE_PATH1 AS contents1, FILE_PATH2 AS contents2, FILE_PATH3 AS contents3, FILE_PATH4 AS contents4, FILE_PATH5 AS contents5, KISA_ORIGCODE AS kisa_origin_code, REAL_ID AS real_id FROM ${tableName} WHERE STATUS = '0' AND REQDATE < GETDATE() ORDER BY REQDATE
